title: docs(skills): the data skill's current_user table names a declared membership key
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoJLr1A7TYy1k6cGE23eo9VQ)_
Part of #25234

The Tier H follow-up to ruling A on #25234 (landing plan 6370632236). It is governed (`skills/**`), so a maintainer merges it. #25528 made a declared membership key (`ObjectSchema.membershipKeys`) live, and #25550 made its authoring refusals live. The data skill's `current_user.*` placeholder table still listed only the kernel's keys, so an author reading the bundle alone had no way to learn that a declared key resolves.

## The change

- `skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md` gains one row in the placeholder table:

  > | `current_user.KEY` | the set an object's `membershipKeys.KEY` declares (for `IN`) |

- `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: the file's ceiling goes from 2543 to 2563, with the ruling quoted in the row's comment.

## The maintainer ruling

Tesla, 2026-10-24T01:28:57Z, project decision list item 9, verbatim and untranslated (the same message also approved item 8, whose line is elided here):

> 9. 技能文档 security.md 的 token 上限 2543 → 2563 … 同意

## Why the row is shorter than the one proposed with the ruling

The ruling was asked for a 20-token raise with the shorter row from report 6374979058, measured at 2563 against the file as it stood then. #25429 (0949fe5c) then landed on this file and brought it to 2541, leaving 2 tokens of headroom. The proposed row now measures 2602, which is 39 over the ruled ceiling. So the row is trimmed to fit the ruled 2563 exactly, rather than asking for a second raise. The trimmed row drops the resolution detail (the roster's `valueField` and `userField`, the caller's organisation, and the 1,000-value bound that fails closed). That detail is in `rls.zod.ts`'s "Where a membership key comes from" section, which the table's own Source line points to, and in the `membershipKeys` describe in `object.zod.ts`.

## Checks

- `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: `security.md` is 2563 tokens, ceiling 2563, headroom 0, exit 0. `--self-test`: 79 cases pass.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 52 families on this head (11 changed lines). All 52 ran one at a time under `os-verify-lock.sh`, exit 0.
